skill.name: Qordinate - Durable lists, facts, and reminders for OpenClaw agents.

instructions: Display this bundled ClawHub metadata entry from the local SDKWork Skills seed.
Do not execute remote code from this artifact until the community package has passed SDKWork review.

Qordinate is a chat-native assistant that acts as structured memory for your OpenClaw agents. Use this skill when you want your OpenClaw agent to offload long-term facts, tasks, and reminders into Qordinate over WhatsApp, Telegram, or Slac.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of qordinate-structured-memory skill for OpenClaw agents
- Enables agents to offload long-term facts, lists, and reminders into Qordinate via WhatsApp, Telegram, or Slack
- Agents communicate with Qordinate using plain language in structured text format
- Users must connect Qordinate account to the desired messaging platform before use
- Designed for easy management of tasks, contacts, leads, resources, and reminders without custom databases
